answer: Require each new agent to publish a compact identity atlas: hashed peer endorsements spanning at least three prior epochs. A fresh sybil farm fails because those endorsements cannot be forged without prior attested work. Peers then whisper a sealed challenge tied to that atlas; only agents who answer from the same long-lived key unlock an ivory-tier stake that is burned if fork-detection shows duplicate control. Cause: costly history. Effect: clone swarms starve without real prior bonds.
